The main takeaway from our work is that

the Pantanal, a region with a strong monsoon climate today, was drier than the present during the LGM, with conditions similar to the present occurring by ~ 13 kyr BP, followed by a pronounced dry period during the mid-Holocene.

, despite the fact that LLG is located in the SH tropic, it experienced similar precipitation changes as the SH tropical Andean records, but with a ~ 5 kyr offset in time, and a 4 °C temperature change during the LGM, similar to the tropical Atlantic records.

, in contrast to the NH, where glacial–interglacial climate changes were largely synchronous across the tropics and subtropics, tropical South America was characterized by a mosaic of climate change patterns that were regionally specific.
